source_note: Authored from the clinician note on inj_knee_left: 'Cleared for low-impact loading; avoid deep knee flexion under load and plyometrics.' Keyed by condition rather than by injury so the same knowledge applies to any member presenting with it.

rules.rationale: Plyometrics are named directly in the clinician note as something to avoid. Impact loading spikes patellofemoral joint reaction force.

Deep flexion under load aggravates the joint, but the pattern encodes neither depth nor load, and the member's goal_knee is a return to pain-free squatting. Down-rank so a coach can prescribe a shallow variation, rather than exclude.
Loaded knee flexion with a long lever at the front knee. Tolerable at partial range, so a penalty rather than a hard exclusion.
Same loaded-flexion pattern as the lunge, with more time under tension at the bottom position.
Moderate knee flexion under load; box height controls the range, so it is often tolerated where a squat is not.
The note clears low-impact loading, which implies repeated-impact locomotion is not yet appropriate at volume.
